name: Nginx Proxy Manager
description: Proxy hosts, settings and your Let's Encrypt certificates.
root_hint: folder mounted at /data in your Nginx Proxy Manager compose file

extra_mounts.label: Certificates
extra_mounts.description: Your Let's Encrypt certificates and account keys (mounted at /etc/letsencrypt). Without them, every certificate has to be requested again.

folders.label: Nginx config
folders.description: The nginx config Nginx Proxy Manager generated for your hosts.

folders.label: Uploaded certificates
folders.description: Certificates you uploaded yourself instead of using Let's Encrypt.

folders.label: Access lists
folders.description: Password files for your access lists.

notes: Your proxy hosts and users are in database.sqlite in this folder. It only changes when you edit hosts or a certificate renews, so it is copied as is; avoid editing hosts at backup time.
If you set Nginx Proxy Manager up with MySQL or MariaDB, back that database up too: use Scan for databases in the plan's sources.
